title: Vertical Control Systems on Tangent Bundles and Fiberwise Controllability
summary: We study control systems on the tangent bundle of a smooth manifold induced by vertical lifts of vector fields. The Vertical dynamics acts exclusively along the fibers, leaving the base point unchanged and reducing the system to a linear control problem on each tangent space, for which we obtain explicit solutions and characterize reachable sets, showing that fiberwise controllability is equivalent to a rank condition on the original vector fields.
